title: Pump Engineering Company — claimed by Dark Project
description: US · Manufacturing · About Pump Engineering Company Pump Engineering Company is a full-service distributor and supplier of industrial pumps, parts, and fluid handling systems, serving Southern California since 1946. During the cyberattack, 120,000 files (115 GB) were stolen, including an extensive customer database, insurance documents, confidential financial documents, and a vast number of project drawings.
